title: Payment Hardship & Financial Distress Signal
description: Customer expresses inability to meet premium payment deadline due to sudden cashflow hardship.

chunks.speaker: Agent
chunks.text: Your quarterly health insurance premium of $680 is scheduled for automatic deduction next Tuesday.

chunks.speaker: Customer
chunks.text: Honestly, I lost some freelance work this month and I cannot afford to pay that right now. I don't have enough money in the account.

chunks.speaker: Agent
chunks.text: I see. Let me check what options we have.
